During the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] tactical briefing aboard the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']] prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Alliance [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] wore the '''Chandrillian Freedom Medal''' around her neck. It was similar to a [[Hanna pendant/Legends|hanna pendant]], a necklace she wore as a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]].
